limit_policy.notes: These values describe Go at $10/month. Official documentation also offers Go Plus at $40/month (2x to 8x the Go monthly limit depending on the model in the current tables) and Go Teams at $20 per member per month (each member gets their own allowances, $5/month higher than Go on every model); both have their own per-model tables that are not represented here. Token prices are identical across all three plans; the 5h = 20% / week = 50% / month = 100% window split applies to each model's monthly limit on every plan.

client_requirements.session_header: OpenCode asks coding-agent clients to send a stable per-conversation session ID so routing and prompt caching can be optimized. x-opencode-session is the generic header; Go also recognizes some clients' native session headers.

validated_clients.Hermes: Update to v0.21.6 or later, which sends the session header on main and auxiliary OpenCode requests (official PR #101864).
validated_clients.Claude Code: Native session header recognized; no custom-header wrapper required.
validated_clients.Codex: Native session header recognized; some versions and proxy setups may omit it, so forwarding must preserve the header.
validated_clients.ZCode: Native session header recognized; x-opencode-session is no longer specifically required.
validated_clients.Pi: Current builds send OpenCode session information; older installations should be updated.
validated_clients.jcode: v0.81.6 or later includes the session-header fix.
validated_clients.Kilo Code CLI: Builds containing PR #13752 restore OpenCode session headers for the CLI; the VS Code extension is not covered by that fix.

problematic_clients.DeepSeek Harness: Session information is present on some model paths but missing on others; Go recognizes its native header, but all adapters do not yet send it consistently.
problematic_clients.GitHub Copilot Chat: Automatic session-header support is still requested upstream.
problematic_clients.Kimi Code: The session-header request in issue #3506 was closed as not planned.
problematic_clients.MiMo Code: Issue #2317 is closed, and PR #2327 was closed without merging.
